audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Singed, Singed, Skill, Skill, Singed, Singed — Singed winning levels 2 and 3 while the whys underneath say 'at L2 he's still helpless' and 'L3 gives you full combo pressure'.
audit.why: The already-audited Singed side records the chart as Yone / Yone / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Singed, and the packet itself flags its own chart as contradicting the data ('Yone wins only 47.85% but the chart gives Yone 5/7 stages'). The mirror reading is the one consistent with a sub-50 win rate: Yone owns the levels before Mega Adhesive, Singed owns everything after he starts proxying.
audit.corrected: Set both layers to Yone, Yone, Skill, Singed, Singed, Singed, Singed and re-point the whys to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes carry no numbers and Insanity Potion is described only as 'buffs his stats and lets him kite harder'.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 125 range — he has to be on top of you to use it, and missing it costs ten seconds. Mega Adhesive is 17s at rank 1. Insanity Potion is a flat 100s and, critically, makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — an anti-heal window the page never mentions.
audit.corrected: Fling's 10s and 125 range as the punish window; Insanity Potion's 100s with Grievous Wounds on the trail as the reason not to chase him on it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability slots are wrong in three places — 'Fling (W)', 'Fling (Q)', 'W poison trail', 'his Q flip' — and the page twice tells the player to escape Fling with Soul Unbound.
audit.why: Poison Trail is Q, Mega Adhesive is W, Fling is E. Beyond the labels, two real interactions are missing. Mega Adhesive grounds: standing in it, Mortal Steel's two-stack dash and Fate Sealed's blink are both unavailable, so the glue is what actually kills Yone here, not the poison. And Fling's own text says a target flung into Mega Adhesive is rooted, so his combo is glue-then-flip. Soul Unbound is not the answer to either: the spirit is forced back to the body Yone left behind, which is a location Singed can see and stand on.
audit.corrected: Fling (E) into Mega Adhesive (W) roots you, and the glue grounds your Q3 dash and Fate Sealed. Sidestep the flip on foot; do not plan to Soul Unbound out of it.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already listed as an early buy, which is right — though the page attributes it to 'his healing' generically when the concrete driver is that Insanity Potion also puts Grievous Wounds on his side of the fight.

edits.before: W shield-grit covers every exchange you start. Only take the trade when Singed's Fling is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is yours — he cannot trade back. Punish every last-hit step before Mega Adhesive arrives.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Singed must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds: inside it you cannot Q3-dash or blink with Fate Sealed. Fight outside the glue, never on it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Fling's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He starts proxying, and Fling into Mega Adhesive roots you. Fling is 10s at rank 1 and 125 range — that is your only window.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Singed's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Insanity Potion, a flat 100 seconds, adds combat stats and puts Grievous Wounds on his poison. Do not chase him on it.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Fling's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King helps, but he buys tank and proxies — the wave, not the duel, is his win here.

edits.before: L3 gives you full combo pressure while Singed has no answer.
edits.after: L3 brings Mega Adhesive: in the goo your dashes are dead.

edits.before: By 4-5 his Fling flip turns the lane into a skill matchup.
edits.after: By 4-5 he proxies and Fling into glue roots you flat.

edits.before: At 6 his R kiting balances your ult, keeping it even.
edits.after: At 6 Insanity Potion adds Grievous Wounds and stats.

edits.before: On first item you out-duel a naked Singed before he goes full tank.
edits.after: On first item he buys Rylai's plus tank stats and stops dying to you.

edits.before: Late you still win a clean 1v1 if you catch him off his poison.
edits.after: Late he proxies and peels, and simply never gives you the 1v1.

edits.before: Late Singed is a poison-trail menace who flips fights with Fling; never chase him through minions or into his gas, and hold E to escape his flip.
edits.after: Late Singed flips fights with Fling (E) into Mega Adhesive (W); never chase through his gas, and don't count on Soul Unbound — it snaps you back to your body.

edits.before: By 4-6 it becomes a skill test: Singed's Fling flips your all-ins and his poison punishes over-commitment, so the mirror hinges on whether you respect his Q flip. Don't dive into his gas trail; bait the Fling, dodge with E, then punish the empty cooldown.
edits.after: By 4-6 he takes over: Fling (E) flips you into Mega Adhesive (W), which grounds you — no Q3 dash, no Fate Sealed out of it. Don't stand in his gas trail; sidestep the flip on foot, then punish the 10-second cooldown before he re-lays the glue.

edits.before: Hold E/R to survive his Fling (W) engage attempts
edits.after: Sidestep Fling (E) on foot, not with Soul Unbound

edits.before: Proxy the wave and dodge you entirely with W poison trail
edits.after: Proxy the wave and dodge you entirely with Poison Trail (Q)

edits.before: Fling (Q) you into gas and his jungler under tower
edits.after: Fling (E) you into Mega Adhesive (W) to root you
